notes: My Shop: upar ka card badlein to neeche usi ki poori details
Mera QR card → kaun aaya (WhatsApp jaisi list): naam, number, ilaka, Visit / Order / Video dekhi
Total Stock card → har item ka stock, Kam / Khatam / Aaj bika
Recent invoices card → saare bill aur order: Chal raha / Delivered / Undelivered / Return
Khata card → kisse lena, kisko dena
Grahak se ilaka bhi (optional) — video dekhne ki suchna bhi
